messages.subject: [Rnomads-user] rNOMADS 2.3.0 released
messages.body_plain:
Hello all,

I recently released a new version of rNOMADS.  It now has support for
downloading multiple ensemble forecast runs using the GrADS-DODS system.  I
also added a function for subsetting the output of GribRead and DODSGrab.
Let me know if you encounter any issues.

Best,

Danny
